hazards.evidence: A large unsecured rug has exposed edges in the walking area and can catch walker legs or feet.
A long cord is coiled and stretched across the rug and main floor walkway.
Shoes and folded linens are on the floor beside the doorway, narrowing the walker path.
Strong direct sunlight creates glare and sharply contrasting shadows across the floor and doorway.
